responsibility: This implementation module provides the full managed dynamic-string runtime for GNU Modula-2. It implements the opaque String representation as chained fixed-size content blocks with a descriptor that caches/export C char* views, tracks temporary garbage strings, and optionally records debug allocation provenance; it consumes Storage allocation, libc string/memory routines, and M2RTS/Assertion support to realize string construction, concatenation, assignment, duplication, slicing, comparison, case folding, whitespace trimming, copy-out, and allocation-stack leak checking, making it the core string subsystem used by higher-level libraries such as FormatStrings, SArgs, and SEnvironment.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation/runtime half of DynamicStrings: it defines the concrete String descriptor and block layout, C-string cache invalidation, temporary-garbage handling, and allocation/debug tracking that are only declared abstractly in DynamicStrings.def.
